answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 69 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. The ocean register is checked at draw time, yarrow lists the eligible set, and jetty seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 69 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. A 78 account operation therefore ties up 35 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
